claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_trait kind + SpeciesTraitRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts has no species_trait variant. The tracer's traceUnit switch handles only spell, class_feature, and mastery — there is no code path for a species trait record at all.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Dragonborn, you have these special traits. ***Draconic Ancestry.*** Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: lineage_choice mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Draconic Ancestry is a passive character-creation parameter choice: the player selects a dragon type which sets a damage type used by Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance. This pattern — a deferred-parameter selection with no activation cost, no use-count, no attack roll, and no save — fits no existing mechanics family (activation, ongoing_effect, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger, on_hit_trigger). A new family is needed to represent 'choose-at-creation parameter that parameterizes other traits'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.
